name: @agent/kernel
description: Coding Agent Kernel v0.1 — small, verifiable, with explicit security boundaries.
comment:dependencies: v0.1 intentionally ships with zero RUNTIME dependencies; typescript, @types/node and prettier are devDependencies used only by `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm format:check`. `pnpm lint` is scripts/lint.ts, a zero-dependency architecture linter — see its header for why it is not ESLint. Node >=22.6 strips TypeScript types natively and provides node:test, fetch, crypto and fs/promises. Glob matching, unified diff, TOML parsing and JSON Schema validation are implemented in src/util/ so that the kernel — and in particular its security tests — can run fully offline with no supply chain surface. See docs/adr/ADR-0009-zero-runtime-dependencies.md.
